status_values.cited: stated in the method paper, docs or code at the given line
status_values.inferred_from_code: follows from the cited code, not stated in words
status_values.约定: 约定，未经推演: not found in the method sources; basis given

canonical_frame: project motion.npz: right-handed Z-up, metres; native Y-up maps (x, y, z) -> (x, -z, y) (utils/motiogen/motion.py:17-18,55-61, applied in utils/motiogen/adapters.py:80-81)
paths: baselines/... are relative to the data root (config/baselines.json data_root); other paths are repository paths

forward_axis.basis: not stated in MotionLCM (its motion_process.py lacks the preprocessing); taken from the shared HumanML3D preprocessing (OmniControl copy motion_process.py:184-207 "All initially face Z+")

units.basis: not stated in MotionLCM; HumanML3D joints are in metres (OmniControl copy metrics.py:152-153 "error for each kps in metre"); control thresholds 0.2 / 0.5 (MotionLCM mld/models/metrics/utils.py:262-263)

floor.definition: learned, not enforced at generation: HumanML3D floors each training sequence at its lowest joint (y = 0) and turns frame 0 to face +Z; the model output has no floor step
floor.basis: HumanML3D preprocessing, copy in baselines/OmniControl/data_loaders/humanml/scripts/motion_process.py:177-179 ("Put on Floor"), 184-207 ("All initially face Z+")
